name: dsh-resource-guard
description: 内存/CPU 压力护栏 for DeepSeek Harness: samples free physical and commit memory, drops the host to below-normal priority with a core cap, and refuses heavy tools (pwsh/bash/workflow/subagent) while the machine is under pressure, plus a launcher that puts the whole Electron tree under a Job Object memory ceiling.

scripts.verify: node scripts/verify-reversible.mjs && node scripts/verify-cap.mjs && node scripts/verify-launcher-job.mjs
